flow.name: keycloak-get-token-flow
flow.doc:description: Exposes POST /gettoken to generate OAuth 2.0 access tokens from Keycloak using Client Credentials grant type

http:listener.doc:name: POST /gettoken
http:listener.doc:description: Receives HTTP POST requests on /gettoken to initiate the OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials flow

logger.doc:name: Log Incoming Request
logger.doc:description: Logs the client remote address for the incoming get-token request

http:request.doc:name: Salesforce Request Keycloak Access Token
http:request.doc:description: POST grant_type=client_credentials to Keycloak token endpoint - validates response status, throws HTTP errors for non-2xx

choice.doc:name: Token Present in Response?
choice.doc:description: Validates that Keycloak returned an access_token field - guards against unexpected empty responses

when.doc:name: access_token present
when.doc:description: Access token is present in the Keycloak response - proceed with normal flow

logger.message: #['[keycloak-get-token-flow] Obtained ' ++ (payload.token_type default 'Bearer') ++ ' token. Expires in: ' ++ (payload.expires_in as String default '0') ++ 's']
logger.doc:name: Log Token Retrieved
logger.doc:description: Logs the token type and expiry duration from the successful Keycloak token response

ee:transform.doc:name: Transform Token Response
ee:transform.doc:description: Serializes access_token, token_type, expires_in and scope from the Keycloak response to application/json

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { access_token: payload.access_token, token_type: payload.token_type, expires_in: payload.expires_in, scope: payload.scope default "" }

otherwise.doc:name: access_token missing
otherwise.doc:description: Negative: Keycloak returned 200 but no access_token - raise APP:VALIDATION to return 400 INVALID_REQUEST

logger.message: [keycloak-get-token-flow] Keycloak returned 200 but access_token is missing - unexpected response
logger.doc:name: Log Missing Token Error
logger.doc:description: Logs the unexpected case where Keycloak returned 200 without an access_token field

raise-error.description: Keycloak token endpoint returned a response without an access_token field
raise-error.doc:name: Raise Missing Token Error
raise-error.doc:description: Raises APP:VALIDATION error - caught by global error handler and returned as 400 INVALID_REQUEST

flow.name: keycloak-validate-token-flow
flow.doc:description: Exposes POST /validatetoken to validate an OAuth 2.0 access token using Keycloak Token Introspection API

http:listener.doc:name: POST /validatetoken
http:listener.doc:description: Receives HTTP POST on /validatetoken with JSON body containing the access_token field to validate

logger.doc:name: Log Incoming Request
logger.doc:description: Logs the client remote address for the incoming validate-token request

choice.doc:name: access_token in Request Body?
choice.doc:description: Validates that the JSON request body contains a non-empty access_token field before calling Keycloak

when.doc:name: access_token provided
when.doc:description: access_token is present and non-empty - proceed with Keycloak introspection

ee:transform.doc:name: Build Introspect Request Body
ee:transform.doc:description: Extracts access_token from JSON body and encodes it as form-urlencoded token=value string for Keycloak

http:request.doc:name: Salesforce Request Keycloak Token Introspection
http:request.doc:description: POST form-urlencoded token body to Keycloak introspect endpoint - validates response status, throws HTTP errors for non-2xx

choice.doc:name: Token Active?
choice.doc:description: Routes based on the Keycloak introspection active flag - active:true for valid tokens, active:false for invalid/expired tokens

when.doc:name: Token is active
when.doc:description: Token is valid and active - log success and return full claims payload

logger.message: #['[keycloak-validate-token-flow] Token is ACTIVE. Subject: ' ++ (payload.sub default 'unknown') ++ ', Client: ' ++ (payload.client_id default 'unknown')]
logger.doc:name: Log Active Token
logger.doc:description: Logs the token subject and client ID for a valid active token from Keycloak introspection

ee:transform.doc:name: Transform Active Token Response
ee:transform.doc:description: Serializes the full active token introspection response including all JWT claims to application/json

otherwise.doc:name: Token is inactive
otherwise.doc:description: Negative: Token is invalid or expired (active:false) - log warning and return standard inactive response per RFC 7662

logger.message: [keycloak-validate-token-flow] Token introspection returned active:false - token is invalid or expired
logger.doc:name: Log Inactive Token
logger.doc:description: Logs a warning when Keycloak reports the token as inactive - could be expired, revoked, or malformed

ee:transform.doc:name: Transform Inactive Token Response
ee:transform.doc:description: Returns standard RFC 7662 inactive token response with active:false when Keycloak reports token as invalid or expired

ee:message.ee:set-payload:
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "active": false, "message": "token is invalid or expired"
}

otherwise.doc:name: access_token missing or empty
otherwise.doc:description: Negative: The request body is missing the access_token field or it is empty - raise APP:VALIDATION to return 400 INVALID_REQUEST

logger.message: [keycloak-validate-token-flow] Validation failed: access_token is missing or empty in request body
logger.doc:name: Log Validation Error
logger.doc:description: Logs the validation failure when the required access_token field is absent or blank in the request body

raise-error.description: access_token is required in the request body. Example: {"access_token": "eyJhbGci..."}
raise-error.doc:name: Raise Missing access_token Error
raise-error.doc:description: Raises APP:VALIDATION error - caught by global error handler and returned as 400 INVALID_REQUEST
